meta.description: A circular radio control for single-select groups. 39 variants across Style (Default/Check) × State (Default/Pressed/Disabled) × Size (Large/Medium/Small) × isSelected × isError.

verdict.title: Keep — structurally clean
verdict.text: All four DS Health traits pass and nothing is open. Five independent axes — Style, State, Size, isSelected, isError — with a vector ring and dot at all three sizes, and a real Pressed state.

overview.inContextNote: How the radio button appears in real product screens — Yes / No answers on a Fill Information form, and a choice of when a recurring payment ends.

traits.name: Reusable
traits.note: Works across forms, surveys, preference pickers, and single-select list rows. Three sizes (24 / 20 / 16) cover the Large, Medium, and Small text scales, and the Check style extends it to iOS-style picker rows without a second component.

traits.name: Self-contained
traits.note: Every size is built from layered vectors — container → circle (fill) + ring (stroke) — so tokens propagate to all three. Carries its own selection, error, and interaction styling; the raster imgContainer export is gone.

traits.name: Consistent
traits.note: Five orthogonal props — Style × State × Size × isSelected × isError. No conditional axes and no invalid combinations: pressed lives in State alongside Disabled, error is its own boolean, and booleans are lowercase true/false. Matches Button v4.0 and Select Item.

traits.name: Composable
traits.note: Nests inside Radio Button – With Label, which mirrors this schema exactly — same props, same order, same 39 variants. Layers are semantic (container / circle / ring) and the Check style is a vector icon instance rather than a drawn shape.

behavior.notes: Empty ring. Resting state for every unpicked option in a group.
Brand ring + inner dot, both #005CE5. Exactly one option per group carries this.
Ring and dot darken to #2340A9. Combines with either isSelected value. Derived at runtime from the touch interaction — not a parameter you pass.
Muted ring and dot. Ships at both isSelected values, so a disabled group can render its unselected options.
Ring and dot switch to #D61B2C. Orthogonal to State — combines with Default and Pressed.
Filled circle + vector checkmark instead of a dot. For single-select list rows; only meaningful when selected.

resolved.body: v2.0: Variant matrix restructured into orthogonal axes — Style (Default/Check) × State (Default/Pressed/Disabled) × Size (Large/Medium/Small) × isSelected × isError. selected no longer conflates selection with modifier states, and no property is conditional on another. (C2)

v2.0: Pressed folded into State, error split into an orthogonal isError boolean — removes the illegal Disabled + Pressed combination the old two-axis model allowed, and matches the Button v4.0 / Select Item pattern. (C2/C4)

v2.0: Large radio rebuilt as layered vectors — container → circle (ELLIPSE fill) + ring (ELLIPSE stroke), both on #005CE5. The pre-rendered imgContainer raster is gone, so token changes now propagate to every size. (C3)
v2.0: Misleading .base/checkbox frame renamed — layers are now container / circle / ring. (C6)
v2.0: Pressed state added — State=Pressed covers touch feedback across Default, Check, and error variants (#2340A9). Focused is N/A on mobile: touch has no focus ring. (C5)
v2.0: Disabled + isSelected=false added at all three sizes — a disabled radio group can now render its unselected options, which was previously impossible. (C5)
v2.0: Boolean variant values lowercased to true/false, matching the C2 convention. (C2)
v2.0: Checkmark promoted to a vector icon instance (Checkmark → Grid) rather than a drawn shape. (C6)

v2.0: Disabled deliberately excludes isError — confirmed as an intentional omission, not a gap. A locked control offers the user no path to resolve a validation error, so the combination has no affordance and ships no variants. (C5)

v2.0: Style=Check confirmed as intentional — retained rather than retired, now shipping as a vector icon instance with full Default / Pressed / Disabled coverage. Usage guidance added to disambiguate it from Checkbox. (C6)

appliedRecommendations.headline: Split properties into orthogonal axes.
appliedRecommendations.body: v2.0: Applied — and taken further than proposed. Style × State × Size × isSelected × isError, with pressed folded into State and error split out as its own boolean. No invalid combinations remain.

appliedRecommendations.headline: Rebuild the large radio as vector layers.
appliedRecommendations.body: v2.0: Applied — every size is now container → circle + ring vector ellipses. Tokens flow to all three sizes.

appliedRecommendations.headline: Rename the internal frame.
appliedRecommendations.body: v2.0: Applied — .base/checkbox is gone; layers are container / circle / ring.

appliedRecommendations.headline: Add pressed states.
appliedRecommendations.body: v2.0: Applied — State=Pressed maps touch feedback to #2340A9. Focused was dropped as N/A on mobile.

appliedRecommendations.headline: Document when to use Check vs Default.
appliedRecommendations.body: v2.0: Applied — the Check style was reviewed and deliberately retained rather than retired. Usage guidance now disambiguates it from Checkbox: Check for single-select list rows, Default (filled dot) for forms where real Checkboxes appear alongside.

appliedRecommendations.headline: Record Disabled + isError as an intentional omission.
appliedRecommendations.body: v2.0: Applied — reviewed and confirmed deliberate. A locked control offers no path to resolve a validation error, so the combination ships no variants by design.

usageSnippets.swift: // Unselected — the empty ring EBRadioButton(isSelected: $selected) .controlSize(.large) // One option in a single-select group ForEach(options) { option in EBRadioButton(isSelected: .constant(option == choice)) .onTapGesture { choice = option } }
usageSnippets.compose: // Unselected — the empty ring EBRadioButton( selected = selected, onClick = { selected = true }, size = EBRadioSize.Large ) // One option in a single-select group options.forEach { option -> EBRadioButton( selected = option == choice, onClick = { choice = option } ) }

usageSnippets.compose: // Checkmark disc — settings and picker rows. // Built only as selected; there is no unselected Check. EBRadioButton( selected = true, onClick = { }, style = EBRadioStyle.Check, size = EBRadioSize.Large )

usageSnippets.swift: // Failed validation the user can still act on EBRadioButton(isSelected: $selected) .ebInvalid(true) // Locked. Never pair .disabled(true) with .ebInvalid(true) — // Figma ships no Disabled + isError variant. EBRadioButton(isSelected: .constant(true)) .disabled(true)
usageSnippets.compose: // Failed validation the user can still act on EBRadioButton( selected = selected, onClick = { selected = !selected }, isError = true ) // Locked. Never pair enabled = false with isError = true — // Figma ships no Disabled + isError variant. EBRadioButton( selected = true, onClick = { }, enabled = false )

accessibility.ios: Inherit radio semantics via Toggle(isOn:) with radio style
Wrap options in a .accessibilityElement(children: .contain) with group label
The control is 24 / 20 / 16pt — every size needs a 44 × 44pt hit area around it
accessibility.android: The control is 24 / 20 / 16dp — every size needs a 48 × 48dp hit area around it

accessibility.ios: Pair with a label and announce the error message after the label
Unselected + Disabled is the default ring at 40% opacity — do not rely on it alone; dim the paired label too

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Style=Check for single-select list rows — settings pickers, option lists, and full-width choice rows where the checkmark reads as "this one is chosen" (the iOS picker convention).
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don't use Style=Check in a form where real Checkboxes appear alongside it — the two become visually indistinguishable. Use Style=Default (filled dot) there; the dot is the universal single-select affordance.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use isError=true together with State=Default or Pressed to flag a failed validation the user can still act on.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don't expect Disabled + isError — it ships no variants by design. A locked control gives the user no way to resolve the error, so surface the message elsewhere (e.g. a Callout or Alert) rather than on the radio.

usageGuidelines.doText: Pair Size to the surrounding text scale — Large (24) for 18px labels, Medium (20) for 16px, Small (16) for dense lists.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don't mix sizes within a single radio group — every option in one group should share the same Size and Style.

usageGuidelines.doText: Reach for Style=Check only when the row is already selected-or-not; it exists in nine variants, all isSelected=true.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don't try to render an unselected or errored Check — Figma builds neither. Fall back to Style=Default for those states.

scorecard.notes: Semantic throughout — container → circle + ring; the misleading .base/checkbox frame is gone (v2.0). The four error-selected variants carry a stroke on container as well as on ring — harmless, but one of them is redundant.
Five orthogonal axes, no conditional properties. Booleans use the is prefix with lowercase true/false values — the reference implementation of the C2 boolean convention.

Every fill is consistent across all three sizes, so nothing is size-specific or raster-baked. Two gaps: Disabled + isSelected=false paints the ordinary #D7E0EF ring at opacity 0.4 rather than binding a disabled token — while Disabled + isSelected=true does use a distinct #9BC5FD; and variable bindings themselves cannot be read with the Talk To Figma plugin, so the token paths on the Style tab are attested, not verified.
Every axis maps to a native parameter or modifier — Toggle with a radio style on iOS, Modifier.selectable(role = Role.RadioButton) on Android. No web-only patterns.
Default, Pressed and Disabled ship at all three sizes for both Style values. Disabled + isError is absent on purpose — recorded, not a gap. Focused is N/A on mobile.

All vector — the pre-rendered large radio is gone and the Check glyph is an icon instance. One gap: the glyph does not scale between sizes. Large and Medium both draw a 16 × 16 icon with a 3px stroke, so at Medium it fills proportionally more of the disc; only Small steps down to 12 × 12 / 2.25px.

variants.description: Style (2) × State (3) × Size (3) × isSelected (2) × isError (2) = 72 theoretical · 39 ship. Check is built only as isSelected=true, isError=false, which accounts for 27 of the 33 absent slots; the remaining 6 are Disabled paired with isError=true, omitted on purpose — a locked control gives the user no way to resolve the error. Summary groups all three sizes per row; node IDs are in the full breakdown.

changelog.header: Style + Code tabs rebuilt against the live component · node 26184:2588

rows.body: Style tab rebuilt off the live component. The documented control was not the one Figma ships: it described a selected enum (unselected/selected/disabled/error), a style axis of default/filled/checkmark, and two sizes. Replaced with the real five axes read from node 26184:2588.

Four colour values were wrong and one state was missing entirely. The selected inner dot was documented white — it is #005CE5, the same blue as the ring, and white appears only as the Check glyph. Disabled-selected was #C2CFE5, actually #9BC5FD. The whole Pressed state (#ADBDDC · #2340A9 · #B50707) was undocumented, as was Size=Medium.

Ring stroke corrected and made size-aware. The Layout section said 1.5px while the colours table said 2px; both were wrong. Read off the SVG exports: 3px at Large, 2.5px at Medium, 2px at Small, with the inner dot at exactly half the box.

Demo panel now mirrors the Figma property panel. One spec card carrying all five properties — Style · State · Size · isSelected · isError — in panel order, with Figma’s own value order and lowercase boolean values. Combinations Figma does not build are disabled rather than offered: reachable 39 equals built 39.
Second colours table was dead markup. colorsTables[i] pairs positionally with specCards[i], so with one card the second table never rendered. Merged into a single Colors by Style and State table.

Code tab scorecard contradicted the v2.0 record. C1 still cited the .base/checkbox frame, C2 the mixed selected axis, C3 the raster large radio, C5 the missing pressed state, C6 the pre-rendered image — all five resolved in v2.0 and recorded as such on the Overview tab. Rescored C1, C2, C4 and C5 Ready.

Property Mapping rewritten against the current schema. It still mapped the retired axes — selected=unselected/selected, size=small/large, style=filled/checkmark marked "retire". Now one prose row per property with all its values, plus the selection callback.

Installation coordinates corrected. Gradle artifact was com.eastblue.ds:radio at version 1.0.0; the slug is radio-button and the version tracks this entry. Import block added — import EastBlueDS and com.eastblue.ds.radio.*, the package derived from the Radio family.

Variants Inventory gained a full breakdown. 39 rows carrying every node ID and its verified fill, behind the summary. The absent-slot arithmetic is now stated: 33 of 72 theoretical, being 27 Check (built only as isSelected=true, isError=false) and 6 Disabled + isError.

Correction to v2.0.0. That entry recorded Disabled + isError=true as "9 slots absent". It is 6 — two combinations (isSelected false and true) across three sizes. The v2.0.0 entry is left as written; this row is the correction.

Disabled uses two different mechanisms. Unselected-disabled wraps the ordinary #D7E0EF ring in opacity 0.4; selected-disabled uses a distinct #9BC5FD at full opacity. One native modifier cannot express both. Logged against C3, not yet filed as an Overview issue.
Check glyph does not scale between Large and Medium. Both draw a 16 × 16 icon at stroke-width 3 inside a 24px and a 20px disc; only Small steps down to 12 × 12 at 2.25. Logged against C6.

Token bindings unread. The Talk To Figma plugin returns no variable bindings, so 8 of the 15 colour rows carry — and the rest are attested from the previous record where the hex still agreed. Needs a Dev Mode pass.

Large radio rebuilt as vector layers — container → circle + ring ellipses on #005CE5. The pre-rendered imgContainer raster is gone; tokens now propagate to all three sizes. Resolved
Layer naming fixed + checkmark promoted to an icon — .base/checkbox replaced by container / circle / ring; the Check style now nests a vector Checkmark icon instance. Resolved
